caption:
Over the past week, Retinol has become a concern for many of the patients in my office. 

Retinol is a form of Vitamin A which is used to help eliminate and reduce signs of aging, improve appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, and improve skin texture. Retinol products should ONLY be used at night since sunlight can weaken its effect and cause sun sensitivity. Retinol also increases collagen production, which can reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, giving your skin a fresher, plump
